draw.io read-only viewer runtime

Source: https://viewer.diagrams.net/js/viewer-static.min.js
Retrieved: 2026-10-26
SHA-256: 2ac3234bb654d99a80130b35a177611791eacb13bfce4e0c444c90223d5f718e
Upstream: https://github.com/jgraph/drawio
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and retained embedded third-party notices.

The upstream bundle is unmodified. MAVIS loads it only inside a sandboxed
read-only iframe with a restrictive CSP. No XML is sent to an external viewer.
The full draw.io editor remains an independent local service.
